book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Yecho ipelekwa palonge jha Pilatu
Bhahe, lilongo lyoha lya bhando bhajhakumpeleka Yecho palonge jha Pilatu.

Bhajhakutumbula kuntakalila bhalongila, “Tumwehine mundo hojho abhahobhecha bhando bhito. Na kabhele abhahibhilikiya bhando bhakotoka kupiya kode kwa munahota nkolongwa jwa ku Loma, na jwenio akikema ndi Kilichitu, Munahota nkolongwa.”
Pilatu ajhakunkonya Yecho, “Bho, mwenga ndi Munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude?” Yecho ngajhangwila, “Chakaka mwenga ndi milongela.”
Peniya Pilatu ajhakwalobholela akapiya matambiko bhakolo na lilongo lya bhando, “Nikihwene ndeka chalemwite mundo jhonjone.”
Nambo bhene bhajhakukangamala bhalongila, “Kwa mabholo ghake abhakokolekeya bhando bhataungane na unahota nkolongwa gwa ku Yudeya. Atumbulii ku Galilaya ade kongo.”
Yecho ipelekwa kwa Helode
Pilatu pajhohina gheniya, ajhakukonya Yecho, “Bho, mundo jhonjo jwa ku Galilaya?”
Pilatu pamanyita Yecho ahumii ku kilambo chikilongochwa na Helode, ndi ajhakupeleka kwa Helode, jwakibha ku Yeluchalemo kwa machiko gheniya.
Helode pamwonita Yecho akahanganii hake nhwalo kwa machiko ghamahele apata ammone, akajhohine malobhe ghake, akibha ahobholila Yecho ahenge ilebhe ya kukangacha.
Bhahe, Helode ajhakunkonya machwale ghamahele, nambo Yecho akajhangwii jhe.
Akapiya matambiko bhakolo na bhabhola bha Malaghalikilo bhubhajhemita peniya, bhajhakughagha kwa likakala Yecho atakalilwe.
Bhahe, Helode na akakomana ngondo bhake bhajhakuntendela Yecho ghanganandela na chanake, peniya bhajhakuwalicha ngobho yambone ngita munahota nkolongwa na kumujhicha kwa Pilatu.
Kuhumii peniya, Helode na Pilatu bhajhakubhehe maghumba nde, nambo makacho bhakibha mu maghonga.
Yecho ihadabulwa akomwe
Pilatu ajhakwakema pamonga akapiya matambiko bhakolo na ilongoche ya bhando,

peniya ajhakwalobholela, “Munetite mundo jhonjo kwa nenga ngita mundo jwahobhecha bhando bhakomane na unahota nkolongwa gwa ku Loma. Nenga nikonyite palonge jhino, nambo kibhiijhe chalemwite mu matakalilo ghake.
Jwenio Helode atubhujhichile helahela twenga, nhwalo akiwejhe chalemwite. Peniya mundo hojho atehi ndeka kilebhe chochoha chikimpala akomwe.
Bhahe, nanichwapula luyato lwa ndomondo na kunekekehe ajhende.”
Nhwalo Pilatu achokolikiya adindulile mpungwa jhumo paunyagho gwa Pachaka.
Nambo lilongo lyoha lya bhando lijhakunonoha malobhe, “Mumohe pamba! Na mutudindulile Balaba!”
Balaba akatabhitwe mukipungo kwa kuhenga majhoghe ghighakapitile kubomane helahela nhwalo gwa kukoma bhando.
Bhahe, Pilatu akapahile kunekekeya Yecho, peniya ndi ngalongila nabho kabhele.
Nambo bhene bhajhakuchocha kunonoha malobhe, “Mumambe panchala! Mumambe pachalaba!”

Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakulonge mala jha utato na kwakonya, “Bho, nhwalo gwa nike? Bho, kilebhe ghane chalemwihe mundo hojho? Nikihwe ndeka chalemwite chikimpala akomwe. Bhahe, nanichwapula luyato lwa ndomondo na kunekekeya ajhende.”
Nambo bhajhakujhendelela kuchobhela hake, bhapata Yecho abhambwe panchalaba. Na kwa kuchobhela kwabhe bhajhakuntenda Pilatu ajheketele.
Bhahe, Pilatu ajhakulonge, unhenge ngita chimipala kuhenga.
Ajhakwadindulila mundo jhola jhubhampalita, jwakibha mukipungo kwa nhwalo gwa kuhenga majhoghe na kukoma, na kumpiya Yecho bhantende ngita chibhapala.
Yecho ibhambwa pachalaba
Pibhakibha bhampelika, bhajhakukongana na mundo jhumo liina lyake Simone jwabhelekilwe kuchenda jha ku Kilene, jwahumila kunng'onda. Bhajhakunkamula na kungheghecha nchalaba pahyeto jha Yecho.
Lilongo likolongwa lya bhando lijhakunkengama Yecho, pamonga na akakeghe bhibhakibha bhakwindikina na kunnelela Yecho.
Nambo Yecho ajhakwaghalambukila na kwalobholela, “Makakeghe bhu ku Yeluchalemo! Nkotoka kunelela nenga, mukilelela mabhene na yana hino.
Nhwalo machiko naghabhandikila, bhando nabhalongila, ‘Mbaha kwa mwikeghe jhola jwangamwana, na ntonga, hilu mabhele ghangajhongecha!’
Lichaa lyenio, ndi bhando nabhatumbula kulonge, itombe, ‘Mututilukile!’ Na ihogholo ‘Mutuyekelele!’
Anda bhando bhautendi naha nkongo mmehe, bho, naibhaha bhole kwa nkongo nnyomo?”
Helahela bhajhakwatola bhando bhabhele bhibhatenda ghanganandela, bhakapelikwe bhakomwe pamonga na Yecho.

Pubhahikita chehemo jhikemwa, “Libhonge lya muto,” peniya ndi bhajhakumamba Yecho pamonga na bhibhatehila ghanganandela kila jhumo na nchalaba gwake, jhumo lubhoko lwalelo na jhonge lubhoko lwa ngejha lwa Yecho.
Yecho palongila, “Tate gwango, mwalekekehe nhwalo bhamanyite jhe chibhatenda.” Peniya akalonda bhala bhajhakubhaghana ngobho yake kwa kahumbuumbu nnobhole.

Bhando bhibhakajhemite peniya kulolekeya, na bhene ilongoche ya Kiyahude bhantendela chanake. Bhalongila, “Abhakombwila bhando bhange, akikombole jwenio, anda jwenio ndi Kilichitu Nkomboche jwahaghulilwe na Chapanga!”
Helahela akakomana ngondo bhajhakuntendela chanake, bhajhakuheghelela na kumpekeya divaye jhibhabha,
bhalongila, “Anda chakaka mwenga ndi Munahota nkolongwa jwa Akayahude, mukikombole mabhene!”
Na panane jha nchalaba gwake pakajhandikwe malobhe ghanga, “Jhonjo ndi Munahota Nkolongwa jwa Akayahude.”
Mwihe jhumo pakate jha bhala bhabhele ajhakunigha Yecho, alongila, “Bho, mwenga ndi Kilichitu? Mukikombole mabhene na mutukombole na twenga!”
Nambo mwihe jhonge jhola ajhakupwatalila nnyake anongolila, “Gwe bhole, munendema jhe Chapanga? Na mabhene bhahadabwii ngita jwenio.
Mwenga na nenga bhatuadabwii chipalwa, tupokile malepo ghaghala ghutuhengita. Nambo mundo hojho kibhiijhe kilebhe chalemwite.”
Peniya nganongolila Yecho, “Yecho, ungotoka kunyehwa pumipala kubhehe Munahota nkolongwa gwino!”
Yecho ngajhangwila, “Ninobholela chakaka, kutumbulii ngoheno, natubhaha pamonga na nenga chehemo jha kukangacha jhikemwa ku pepo.”
Yecho ihwe panchalaba
Bhahe, Pihikila muhe jha chaa chita, lubhendo lujhakukamulana tyoo pa kilambo choha ade chaa ticha.
Peniya lipanjiya lilihibhikiya pa Nyumba jha Chapanga lijhakujwepuka jwee ipande ibhele kutumbulii kunane ade pahe.
Yecho ajhakubohoma kanonoha, “Tate gwango, mu mabhoko ghino nibheka uhuke gwango!” Palongila gheniya, ajhakubhehe kakalile.
Jhola nkolo jwa bhakomana ngondo palolita ghighatendika peniya, ajhakunnomba Chapanga alongila, “Chakaka mundo jhonjo akibha jwaumbone!”
Bhahe, lilongo lyoha lya bhando pubhalolita ghighakatindike, bhajhakujhenda bhabhii ngolongonde hake.
Nambo bhando bhoha bhubhakamanyite Yecho bhalingulila chukutale, bhaghalolekehe mambu ghanga. Pakate jhabhe bhakibha akakeghe bhalongohina nabho kuhumii ku Galilaya.
Yegha jha Yecho ibhekwa mumambe
Pakibha na mundo jhumo liina lyake Uchupo, kuhumii ku muche gwa Alimataya ku chenda jha ku Yudeya. Akibha jhumo jwa nkolo jwaumbone pa Bwalo jha Akayahude.

Nambo ahumii ku Alimataya, akajheketii jhe mambu gha pa Bwalo jha Akayahude pubhapata kunkoma Yecho na pubhalenganikiya kuhenga lyenio. Jwenio alolila machaa gha Chapanga pantumita munahota nkolongwa gwake kuhika kulongocha.
Bhahe, Uchupo ajhakujhenda kwa Pilatu kunnyopa atole malelo gha Yecho.
Ajhakuhulua malelo ghala kuhumii panane jha panchalaba, ajhakubhilingilila chanda ajhakughoneka umambe jhibhahokonyolile palindalabho, na mambe jhene ikibhajhe na malelo.
Iikibha lichiko lya Ijumaa ndi libhandikila lichiko lya kutumbula Kupomolela.
Akakeghe bhala bhubhalongohina na Yecho kuhumii ku Galilaya bhajhakunkengama Uchupo na bhajhakubhona mambe na yegha jha Yecho chibhekwite.
Peniya pibhakelewika kajhabhe bhakalenganikiye mahuta ghighanungalila petelele. Na Lichiko lya Kupomolela, bhajhakutama hele ngita Lilaghalikilo chililaghalikiye.
